provider: Senatsverwaltung für Bildung, Jugend und Familie Berlin
attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Bildung, Jugend und Familie Berlin; Kindertagesstätten (WFS kita:kita, revision 2025-12-31), Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Registry of publicly funded Berlin day-care facilities (öffentlich geförderte Kindertagesstätten, incl. parent-initiative Kitas, Eltern-Kind-Gruppen and Waldkindergärten). Privately financed facilities and Kindertagespflege (childminders) are not included.
Dataset revision 2025-12-31 (official metadata, published 2026-05-28, updated annually). The WFS response carries no per-record date; openings and closures after the revision are not reflected.

capacity is 'Erlaubte Platzzahl' (permitted places under the operating licence) as of the dataset revision. It is a licensed maximum, not occupied places, available places or vacancies. Vacancies are not provided and remain null.

Facility counts and permitted places are not proof of a childcare shortage or surplus; demand depends on age-specific care entitlement and uptake, catchment across area borders, and opening hours not measured here.
Do not use Kita-Navigator as a bulk vacancy source: no supported bulk access method or reuse terms were established.
Area counts use a point-in-polygon join to the pinned berlin_lor Planungsräume in EPSG:25833; the source itself supplies only the district number (e_bez_nr).
Source access, license, CRS, paging and field mapping checked 2026-10-18 via WFS GetCapabilities/DescribeFeatureType and the datenregister.berlin.de CKAN metadata.
